{{Quote|Potions, sir. Love potion for your lady friend? Go from friend to lovers before you can say 'space'.|Merchant selling potions in Mos Eisley|<ref name="Nightlily">[[Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale (audio drama)|''Nightlily the Lovers' Tale'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
A '''love potion''' was an elixir or mixture that supposedly would cause a being develop romantic feelings for another.

==History==
The love potion was a mix created by [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] as part of his many potions and tricks. It was a variant of the [[Hate potion]].

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] merchant on the desert [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] was selling potions in the streets of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. She attempted to sell a love potion to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] tax collector, [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]].<ref name="Nightlily" />
